title: Kimura fixation probability of a mutant allele

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Kimura fixation probability of a mutant allele

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The probability that a mutant allele eventually fixes in a finite population depends on its initial frequency, its selective advantage and the effective population size, and equals its initial frequency when it is neutral.

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: u(p) = \frac{1-e^{-4N_e s p}}{1-e^{-4N_e s}}; neutral limit u(p) = p, so a new mutant fixes with probability 1/(2N)

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: diffusion approximation to the Wright-Fisher model, genic (additive) selection with coefficient s, constant effective size N_e, no linkage to other selected sites

fields.label: Notation
fields.value: u(p) = \frac{1-e^{-4N_e s p}}{1-e^{-4N_e s}}; neutral limit u(p) = p, so a new mutant fixes with probability 1/(2N)

fields.label: Proposed test
fields.value: Track the fate of many marked mutations of measured fitness effect in replicate experimental populations of known N_e (e.g. barcoded microbial lineages) and compare fixation frequencies with u(p).
